plain_description: We have no permission to message this person.
condition: consent_marketing is false AND whatsapp_optin_status is not opted_in
action: Block all messaging. Allow one opt in request only.
user_facing_explanation: We cannot message this lead yet because no consent was captured at the form. Send the opt in request or check the form setup.

plain_description: They opted out.
condition: opt_out_flag is true
action: Suppress permanently across every channel.
user_facing_explanation: This person asked us to stop. No message of any kind may be sent unless they re consent in writing.

plain_description: Three sends have failed.
condition: Three consecutive delivery failures across two days
action: Mark invalid. Stop WhatsApp. Try email once if consent exists.
user_facing_explanation: The number is unreachable. Sending more messages will not fix it. This goes to the data quality queue.

plain_description: This person already bought from us.
condition: existing_student_status is active_student AND an acquisition playbook was selected
action: Switch to the cross sell playbook. Change owner to Student Success.
user_facing_explanation: This is an existing student. Acquisition messaging would be wrong and damaging. Student Success owns them.

plain_description: Two records exist for one person.
condition: Phone number already exists on another lead record
action: Merge. Keep the higher scores. Suppress the second first message.
user_facing_explanation: Two records exist for this person. They will get two first messages unless the records are merged.

rule_name: Not eligible for the course requested
plain_description: The awarding body does not allow them to sit this exam yet.
dimensions_affected: Eligibility and stage fit, Course interest
condition: eligibility_status is ineligible
action: Force the redirect playbook. Block any payment link.
user_facing_explanation: They cannot register for this course. Name the reason and the course that is open to them now. Selling around the rule creates a refund.

plain_description: They asked for level two without clearing level one.
dimensions_affected: Eligibility and stage fit, Course interest
condition: Requested course requires a prior level that is not recorded as passed
action: Offer the correct level. Block the payment link for the requested level.
user_facing_explanation: This course needs the earlier level first. Offer that level and explain the sequence.

rule_name: Payment link before the price is agreed
plain_description: About to send a link without a confirmed variant and price.
condition: payment_link_requested is true AND variant or price is not confirmed
action: Block the link. Send the confirmation message first.
user_facing_explanation: Confirm exactly which variant and what price before the link goes out, otherwise the wrong product gets bought.

rule_name: The person who pays has not been spoken to
plain_description: A parent or employer signs off and has never been contacted.
condition: decision_maker is parent or employer AND that person has never been contacted
action: Add the decision maker asset. Create a call task in the correct window.
user_facing_explanation: The person who signs off has not been spoken to. The sale cannot close through the student alone.

rule_name: Course does not suit the life stage
plain_description: Technically allowed but wrong for where they are.
condition: stage_suitability is premature or overqualified
action: Recommend the correct entry or next product and explain the sequence.
user_facing_explanation: This is not the right step for them right now. Recommending it anyway produces a dropout, not a student.

rule_name: Not enough hours for the variant
plain_description: They cannot give the time the course needs.
condition: weekly_study_hours below 8 AND the recommended variant is a full immersion product
action: Switch to the shorter variant, or propose the next attempt.
user_facing_explanation: They have fewer hours than this variant needs. Offer the shorter variant or a later attempt rather than agreeing.

rule_name: Exam is too close to start honestly
plain_description: Under 30 days to the exam and nothing has been studied.
condition: days_to_target_exam below 30 AND preparation_status is not started
action: Propose the next window. Do not sell the current attempt.
user_facing_explanation: There is not enough time left for this attempt. Say so and plan the next window.

rule_name: Two sources disagree on life stage
plain_description: The form and the reply say different things.
condition: Two sources of equal precedence give different life stage values
action: Flag the field. Suppress every message block that names the life stage. Raise a verification task.
user_facing_explanation: We have two different answers for what they are doing. Until it is resolved the message will not mention it.

plain_description: The form says one course, the reply says another.
condition: Form value and declared reply name different courses
action: Use the most recent explicit statement. Flag the other. Ask which one in the next message.
user_facing_explanation: They have named two different courses. Ask which one rather than assuming.

rule_name: Event city is not their city
plain_description: They attended an event somewhere they do not live.
condition: Event location differs from the recorded city
action: Drop every location reference from the message.
user_facing_explanation: Mentioning either city would read as a mistake, so the message will not mention location at all.

plain_description: We inferred the course from a landing page.
condition: Course confidence is inferred low
action: Confirm with a question before any commercial step.
user_facing_explanation: We think they want this course but they never said so. Confirm before quoting a price.

rule_name: Life stage was guessed, never confirmed
plain_description: We inferred the life stage from the source.
condition: Life stage confidence is inferred low
action: Block copy that names the life stage. Ask one question.
user_facing_explanation: We are not sure whether they are studying or working, so the message will not assume either.

rule_name: Strong intent built on very little information
plain_description: High intent score from very few known fields.
condition: intent_score at 61 or above AND data completeness below 40 percent
action: Keep the priority. Flag low confidence on the briefing card.
user_facing_explanation: They look keen but we know very little about them. Treat the score as provisional.

plain_description: Declared urgency is not matched by any activity.
condition: purchase_timeline is immediate AND no engagement for 14 days
action: Reduce the declared urgency component. Re verify the timeline.
user_facing_explanation: They told us they were ready two weeks ago and have done nothing since. Ask again rather than assuming.

rule_name: Educational content queued for a buyer
plain_description: About to send a career guide to someone asking for a payment link.
condition: Intent is transactional AND the selected resource is a discovery asset
action: Replace with the transactional asset.
user_facing_explanation: This person is trying to buy. Sending a career guide reads as a stall.

plain_description: Brochure selected when no course is known.
condition: Course is unknown AND the resource is the course brochure
action: Replace with the discovery asset.
user_facing_explanation: A brochure answers questions they have not asked yet. It ends discovery conversations.

plain_description: About to re send something they already opened.
condition: Selected resource already appears in resource_opened_ids
action: Move to the next step resource.
user_facing_explanation: They have already seen this. Send the next thing, not the same thing.

plain_description: The message asks more than two questions.
condition: Assembled message contains more than two questions
action: Trim to one question.
user_facing_explanation: More than two questions in one message reads as a form and gets ignored.

plain_description: More than one link in one message.
condition: Assembled message contains more than one link
action: Drop all but the primary link.
user_facing_explanation: One link per message. Five links is how a conversation ends.

plain_description: Copy references a field that is currently in conflict.
condition: Assembled copy references any field listed in field_conflict_flags
action: Fall back to the neutral variant of that block.
user_facing_explanation: We are not certain about this detail, so the message will not mention it.

plain_description: A placeholder did not fill in.
condition: Assembled message still contains an unresolved placeholder
action: Fall back to the neutral variant of the whole message.
user_facing_explanation: A message with a blank where a name or price should be does more damage than a generic one.

rule_name: Opening as if this is first contact
plain_description: We have spoken to them before.
condition: Previous interaction exists AND the message uses a first contact opening
action: Switch to the relationship opening.
user_facing_explanation: We have spoken before. Opening as a stranger loses the only advantage we have.

rule_name: Cross sell to a struggling student
plain_description: Selling more to someone behind schedule or with a complaint open.
condition: Active student AND behind schedule OR an open support ticket
action: Suppress the cross sell entirely.
user_facing_explanation: Selling more to a student who is behind damages both the sale and the relationship.

rule_name: Reactivation with nothing new to say
plain_description: Waking a dormant lead with no new fact.
condition: Playbook is dormant reactivation AND no entry exists in the new fact register
action: Send nothing. Wait for a real fact.
user_facing_explanation: There is nothing new to tell them. A check in with no news is what produces opt outs.

plain_description: It is the middle of the night where they live.
condition: Local time is outside 08:00 to 21:00
action: Queue until the next permitted window.
user_facing_explanation: It is outside contact hours where they live. The message is queued, not cancelled.

plain_description: The cadence cap has been reached.
condition: Messages this week at or above the cohort cap
action: Hold until the cap resets.
user_facing_explanation: They have already had the maximum messages for this week. More now costs replies.

plain_description: Under 21 days to their exam.
condition: days_to_target_exam below 21
action: Reduce cadence to one message per fortnight. Pause school playbooks during boards.
user_facing_explanation: Their exam is close. Reduce contact rather than increasing it.

rule_name: We did not understand the reply
plain_description: The reply classifier is below its confidence threshold.
condition: Classifier confidence below 0.7
action: Pause automation. Create a human reply task within 4 working hours.
user_facing_explanation: We did not understand the reply well enough to answer it automatically. A person will read it.

rule_name: Nobody free for a ready to buy lead
plain_description: A call now lead has no available counsellor.
condition: Priority is call now AND no counsellor has capacity
action: Escalate to the manager queue and notify.
user_facing_explanation: This lead is ready to buy and nobody is free. It goes to the manager queue rather than waiting.

plain_description: No cohort rule fired for this lead.
condition: No cohort rule matched
action: Use the discovery playbook and log the miss.
user_facing_explanation: No cohort fitted this lead. Discovery is used and the gap is logged for review.

plain_description: A tie between two cohorts.
condition: Two or more cohorts tie on specificity
action: Take the lower rule ID and log the tie.
user_facing_explanation: Two cohorts fitted equally well. One was chosen and the tie is logged, because a tie usually means a missing rule.

plain_description: Under 18.
condition: Life stage is class 9 to 10 or class 11
action: Parent facing communication only.
user_facing_explanation: This is a minor. Communication goes to the parent. Legal review is required before this playbook runs.

plain_description: They asked for their money back recently.
condition: A refund was processed in the last 90 days
action: Suppress all selling. Route to a service review.
user_facing_explanation: They refunded recently. Selling again now is the wrong move.

rule_name: Missing the one field this cohort needs
plain_description: The cohort cannot be confirmed without a specific field.
condition: A field marked mandatory for the matched cohort is blank
action: Ask that single question before advancing the playbook.
user_facing_explanation: One piece of information is missing before we can be sure. Ask for it and nothing else.

rule_name: Asked the same question three times
plain_description: Profiling questions are going unanswered.
condition: profiling_questions_asked is 3 or more
action: Stop asking. One counsellor attempt, then park.
user_facing_explanation: Three questions have gone unanswered. Asking a fourth reads as an interrogation.
